findings.evidence: Line 130 `toReal_apply_eq_of_fin_two (A : TransportMatrix μ ν) (i j : Fin 2)` holds for every `A`, so it applies to `ofTwoByTwoParameter x`; its proof (lines 135-140) uses only `sum_toRealFun_row/col` and `PMF.toReal_apply_zero_add_toReal_apply_one`, and `ofTwoByTwoParameter_apply_zero_zero` (line 115) is proved independently, so there is no circularity.
findings.fix: Move `toReal_apply_eq_of_fin_two` above `ofTwoByTwoParameter_toReal_apply` and prove the latter by `rw [toReal_apply_eq_of_fin_two, ofTwoByTwoParameter_apply_zero_zero]`, dropping the separate `fin_cases`/`simp` computation and the `twoByTwoParameter_bounds` unfolding there.
findings.issue: `ofTwoByTwoParameter_toReal_apply` re-derives all four real entries by `fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> simp [ofTwoByTwoParameter, ...]`, duplicating the general `toReal_apply_eq_of_fin_two` (line 130), which already determines every entry of any transport matrix from its `(0,0)` entry.

findings.evidence: Lines 50-57 introduce `A.sum_toRealFun_row 0/1`, `A.sum_toRealFun_col 0`, `toRealFun_nonneg (1,1)` and both PMF sum lemmas and close with `linarith`; lines 135-140 introduce the identical hypotheses and close with `norm_num <;> linarith`.
findings.fix: Place `toReal_apply_eq_of_fin_two` first in the namespace and obtain the bound from `A.toRealFun_nonneg (1, 1)` rewritten by `toReal_apply_eq_of_fin_two A 1 1`, instead of re-assembling the row/column sums.
findings.issue: The lower-bound branch of `twoByTwoParameter` repeats the same elimination a third time: `hrow`, `hrow1`, `hcol`, `h11`, `hμ`, `hν`, `linarith` reproduces exactly the `(1,1)` case of `toReal_apply_eq_of_fin_two`, i.e. `(A 1 1).toReal = 1 - μ₀ - ν₀ + (A 0 0).toReal`.

summary: Statements are at the natural level with no unused or over-strong hypotheses. But the general entry formula `toReal_apply_eq_of_fin_two` is proved for every transport matrix and then two special cases of it are re-proved by hand instead of derived; reorder and derive them.
